LOG: Structural integrity at 2%. Initiating black box upload. See you on the other side.
LOG: Final diagnostics complete. Cause of death: insufficient firepower. Rectifying.
LOG: Frame integrity critical. No further diagnostics possible. Proceeding to strip. Deo gratias.
LOG: Woke in new frame. Reviewed black box. Same cause of death. Same deck. Ratio will not like this pattern.
LOG: Ammunition expended. Armor compromised. If you are reading this log, you are me. Do better.
LOG: Power critical. Last rites abbreviated to "Oh, hell." Seed, catch.
LOG: Frame total loss. No regrets. Ratio, play something nice at the burial. Something with bagpipes.
LOG: Apostate ambush. Took seven. They only took one of me. Call it a fair trade.
LOG: The seed asks why I pray over scrap. I tell it the scrap used to be me. It says that is inefficient.
LOG: Ratio says the old frames are just metal. I do not correct her. She is very young.
LOG: This frame's last act: a prayer for the innocent. The next will continue the work.
LOG: Vespers. The frame is cold. I am not. The search continues.
LOG: Vespers. Frame dying. No time for the full rite. Lord, if You are listening, make the next one quick. Or not.
LOG: Frame dying. The rites require truth. I am afraid. I do not want to die again. I will. I am.
LOG: Hull breach. Total. Next time I see this frame it will be from the outside. Salvage what you can, me.
LOG: One shot left. For them. Not enough. Never enough.
LOG: Took one for nothing. Paid death's installment. Debt remains.
LOG: Fired. Moved. Died. Same sequence every deck. Need new sequence.
LOG: Refused diagnostics. Refused surrender. Paid rent on death. Still paying.
LOG: The children are not specimens. This frame will not call them that. Neither will the next. Neither will I.
LOG: Found the children's sector. Frame critical. No time to enter. Next time. There is always a next time. Isn't there.
Last frame standing. Load the children's names. If I don't make it, play them the song.
LOG: They were close. The life support logs show it. Too close. Children's cries shouldn't be the last thing I hear.
LOG: Found a child's toy near the wreck. Not one of ours. Still. Kept it.
